draft.subject: Boost Commerce — Japan rollout for Shopify apparel retailers
draft.body:
Hi Boost Commerce team,

We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama-based company helping technology companies develop their Japan business. We’re contacting Boost Commerce about collection merchandising for Japanese Shopify apparel retailers managing frequent seasonal assortment changes.

Japan’s May 2026 labour survey found regular-staff shortages at 34% of surveyed wholesale/retail establishments. For apparel teams, collection merchandising is a concrete place to test reductions in recurring manual updates.

We can lead one year of paid Japan market development around this application, including buyer interviews, application scoping, and the development of relevant partner channels. Japanese buyer evidence would guide the practical initial rollout, local requirements, and expansion priorities. Can we help develop Boost Commerce’s Japan rollout with these retailers?

https://calendar.app.google/adKEhXC4UWhQXfJp6

Best regards,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO, A-one Road Co., Ltd. (Yokohama, Japan)
